questions.chapter: Determinacy, Stability & Principle of Virtual Work
questions.text: Explain Static and Kinematic Indeterminacy ($D_s, D_k$) of plane trusses, beams, and rigid-jointed plane frames with internal releases (hinges, sliders). Calculate $D_s$ and $D_k$ for a two-bay three-story plane frame with fixed bases.

questions.chapter: Deflection of Beams & Frames (Moment-Area, Conjugate Beam, Castigliano)
questions.text: State and prove Mohr's Theorems (Moment-Area Theorems I & II). Calculate the slope and deflection at the free end of a cantilever beam carrying a uniformly distributed load (UDL) of $w\,\text{kN/m}$ over half its span from the fixed support.

questions.chapter: Deflection of Beams & Frames (Moment-Area, Conjugate Beam, Castigliano)
questions.text: State the Conjugate Beam Theorems. Find the slope at supports and maximum deflection for a simply supported beam with varying cross-section (moment of inertia $2I$ in middle half, $I$ near supports) carrying a central point load $W$ using the Conjugate Beam Method.

questions.chapter: Deflection of Beams & Frames (Moment-Area, Conjugate Beam, Castigliano)
questions.text: State Castigliano's First and Second Theorems. State the Principle of Minimum Strain Energy. Find the vertical deflection at the loaded joint of a rigid portal frame using Castigliano's Theorem ($U = \int \frac{M^2 dx}{2EI}$).

questions.chapter: Analysis of Determinate Arches (Three-Hinged Arches) & Suspension Cables
questions.text: A Three-Hinged Parabolic Arch of span $L = 30\,\text{m}$ and central rise $h = 6\,\text{m}$ carries a uniformly distributed load of $20\,\text{kN/m}$ on the left half of the span. Determine: (a) Horizontal thrust $H$, (b) Bending moment, Normal Thrust ($N = V\sin\theta + H\cos\theta$), and Radial Shear ($Q = V\cos\theta - H\sin\theta$) at a section $7.5\,\text{m}$ from the left support. Prove that a three-hinged parabolic arch under full UDL carries zero bending moment everywhere.

questions.chapter: Analysis of Determinate Arches (Three-Hinged Arches) & Suspension Cables
questions.text: Derive equations for maximum cable tension ($T_{max} = \sqrt{H^2 + V_{max}^2}$) and cable length ($L_c = L + \frac{8h^2}{3L}$) for a light flexible suspension cable supported at same level carrying a horizontal UDL. Determine tensions in anchor cables over saddles and guide pulleys.

questions.chapter: Influence Lines for Determinate Beams, Trusses & Arches
questions.text: Define Influence Line Diagram (ILD) and state Muller-Breslau Principle for determinate structures. Draw ILD for support reactions $R_A, R_B$, shear force, and bending moment at a section $X$ for a simply supported beam with an overhang. Using the ILD, find maximum shear force and bending moment caused by a moving train of concentrated wheel loads.

questions.chapter: Energy Theorems & Deflection of Trusses (Unit Load Method)
questions.text: State the Unit Load Method (Virtual Work Principle) for pin-jointed trusses: $\Delta = \sum \frac{P k L}{A E}$. Calculate the vertical and horizontal deflection at the loaded joint of a steel cantilever truss. If one member was fabricated $5\,\text{mm}$ too short, calculate the resulting joint displacement.

questions.chapter: Influence Lines for Determinate Beams, Trusses & Arches
questions.text: Draw Influence Line Diagrams for forces in bottom chord $L_2L_3$, top chord $U_2U_3$, and diagonal $U_2L_3$ of a through-type Warren Pratt bridge truss of span $24\,\text{m}$ with 6 panels.
